mapper.select: select i.item_id, i.baby_id, i.item_name, i.is_builtin, i.sort_num, i.status, l.log_id, coalesce(l.completed, '0') as completed, l.complete_time, l.operator_id, l.operator_name from nc_care_item i left join nc_care_log l on l.item_id = i.item_id and l.baby_id = #{babyId} and l.care_date = #{careDate} where i.del_flag = '0' and i.status = '0' and (i.baby_id is null or i.baby_id = #{babyId}) and not exists ( select 1 from nc_care_hidden h where h.baby_id = #{babyId} and h.item_id = i.item_id ) order by i.is_builtin desc, i.sort_num, i.item_id
select item_id, baby_id, item_name, is_builtin, sort_num, status from nc_care_item where item_id = #{itemId} and del_flag = '0'
mapper.insert: insert into nc_care_item (baby_id, item_name, is_builtin, sort_num, status, del_flag, create_by, create_time, remark) values (#{babyId}, #{itemName}, #{isBuiltin}, #{sortNum}, #{status}, #{delFlag}, #{createBy}, current_timestamp, #{remark})
mapper.update: update nc_care_item set del_flag = '2', update_time = current_timestamp where item_id = #{itemId} and baby_id = #{babyId} and is_builtin = '0' and del_flag = '0'
mapper.insert: insert into nc_care_hidden (baby_id, item_id, create_time) values (#{babyId}, #{itemId}, current_timestamp) on conflict (baby_id, item_id) do nothing

insert into nc_care_log (baby_id, item_id, care_date, completed, complete_time, operator_id, operator_name, create_time, update_time) values ( #{babyId}, #{itemId}, #{careDate}, #{completed}, case when #{completed} = '1' then current_timestamp else null end, #{operatorId}, #{operatorName}, current_timestamp, current_timestamp ) on conflict (baby_id, item_id, care_date) do update set completed = excluded.completed, complete_time = excluded.complete_time, operator_id = excluded.operator_id, operator_name = excluded.operator_name, update_time = current_timestamp
